name: Cryonic-Hamada
description: There is no surface, only an endless fall through banded clouds: amber belts, cream zones, and storms wide enough to swallow worlds. Lightning flickers between the layers like thoughts of a vast mind.

The deck plates hum with distant thunder that never resolves into an actual front. Sleep comes hard at first; later, it comes too easily. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.

The colonists of the monolithic structures of unknown origin kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
